'''February 2001 Paxtonia tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Paxtonia Plaza, Pennsylvania on 17 February 2001. [[Drew Scott]] won it. It is known from Drew Scott's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1738">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01d1738/ paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01], DeckTech (drew "drew man1" scott, 17 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01d1738/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Paxtonia Plaza, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Drew Scott]]
